description.value: You create a link between you and your targets that functions as Shield Other , except that (in addition to affecting multiple targets) while under the effects of the link you may also have any spell that you cast on yourself affect your target creatures as well. All targets must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from the linked spells when they are cast, they may leave this area afterwards but must stay within the range of shield other. Spells that have certain uses or charges share the amount amongst linked creatures, for example, True Strike only grants a single attack a +20 within the linked creatures after which the spell ends, Stoneskin also shares the maximum pool of damage reduction amongst linked creatures. The duration of spells is also split amongst all linked creatures to a minimum of 1 round for each creature. If this spell is dispelled for dismissed, any spells/effects that allies gained through it end.
